verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity emits events on every verification-session status change, and its webhooks let an integration automatically trigger reactions (docs-6, docs-15). Blocklisting a document automatically blocks future verifications that use it (docs-11), and flows save reusable verification configuration (docs-8). However, the trigger logic must be written as webhook-handling code; the evidence shows no built-in rule builder for defining conditions and actions. Missing for 10: a native rules/automation engine for defining event-to-action rules, configurable conditional logic beyond blocklists, and independent or hands-on corroboration of event-driven automation.
